```{r}
library(GEOquery)

gse_181294 <- getGEO("GSE181294", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
#divide the ExpressionSet into the expression matrix and meta data

gse_181294 <- gse_181294[[1]]

#expression matrix

expr_181294 <- exprs(gse_181294)

#meta-data
meta_181294 <- pData(gse_181294)

#showing first five rows of the meta-data and the expression samples
head(expr_181294, n = 5)
head(meta_181294, n = 5)
#download the data into the data directory

# editing inital  metaData
colnames(meta_181294)
meta_181294 <- meta_181294 %>% 
  select(c(title, geo_accession, "age:ch1", "condition:ch1", "gleason:ch1")) %>%
  mutate(`gleason:ch1` = case_when(
    "NA" == `gleason:ch1` ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(`gleason:ch1`, "=") ~ gsub("=.*$", "", `gleason:ch1`))) %>%
  mutate(`gleason:ch1` = trimws(`gleason:ch1`))

#before renaming
meta_181294

#renaming columns
colnames(meta_181294)[colnames(meta_181294) == "gleason:ch1"] <- "bGleason"

colnames(meta_181294)[colnames(meta_181294) == "age:ch1"] <- "Age"

meta_181294
```

```{r}

#extractig the cell names
cell_names <-  rownames(gse181294.obj@meta.data)
cell_names[1:10]
#seperating the cell_names from the GSMXXXXX sample title

saveRDS(gse181294.obj, "./post_qc_rds_files/gse181294.rds")
```

# Finally Integration Time

**Run Normalization**

**Run Variable Features**

Ranks Features by number of dataset they are deemed variable. Because the variance of a genes scales non-linearly with the mean expression of each gene, methods will need to isolate heterogeneity using a normalized or standardized metric. Asking: How much more variable a gene is than expected given it's mean expression

Ways to rank features:

 1. Dispersion-Based

Dispersion_i = variance_i / mean_i

2.  Variance Stabilization method (local polynomial Regression)
3.  Pearson Residual Variance

**Select Integration Features:** Ranks features by the number of datasets they are deemed variable. Breaking ties by the median variable features rank across datasets.

```{r}
library(harmony)
```

```{r}
PCa_list <- list(gse181294.obj, gse150692.obj, gse176031.obj, gse141445.obj)
names(PCa_list) <- c("GSE181294", "GSE150692", "GSE176031", "GSE141445")

#clear individual Seurat objects from active RAM
rm(gse181294.obj, 
   gse150692.obj, 
   gse176031.obj, 
   gse141445.obj)

#perform normalization on each individually
#perform scaleData individually
PCa_list <- lapply(X = PCa_list, FUN = function(x){
  #Log Normalize
  x <- NormalizeData(x, 
                     verbose = FALSE,
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
  #Rank Variable Features 
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, verbose = FALSE,
                            selection.method = "vst",
                            nfeatures = 10000)
})
# Run ScaleData and RunPCA
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(PCa_list)
PCa_list <- lapply(X = PCa_list, FUN = function(x){
  x <- ScaleData(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- RunPCA(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
})

#merge the list of Seurat Object
PCa_object <- merge(
  x = PCa_list[[1]],
  y = PCa_list[-1],
  add.cell.ids = names(PCa_list),
  project = "merge_object"
)
```

```{r}
post_qc_rds <- "merged_objects"

if(!dir.exists(post_qc_rds)){
  dir.create(glue("./{post_qc_rds}"))
}

saveRDS(PCa_object, "./merged_objects/PCa_merged.rds")
```

```{r}

rm(PCa_list)
```

### Harmony

```{r}
#Harmony: directly give covariates to batch correct on
PCa_object <- JoinLayers(PCa_object)
PCa_object <- RunPCA(PCa_object, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

# Run Harmony (corrects batch effects on PCA embedding)
PCa_object_int <- RunHarmony(PCa_object, c("geo_acc", "sampleID"))
rm(PCa_object)
PCa_object_int <- NormalizeData(PCa_object_int, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
PCa_object_int <- FindVariableFeatures(PCa_object_int, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_object_int <- ScaleData(PCa_object_int, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_object_int <- RunPCA(PCa_object_int, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_object_int <- RunUMAP(PCa_object_int, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)
PCa_object_int <- FindNeighbors(PCa_object_int, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
PCa_object_int <- FindClusters(PCa_object_int, resolution = 0.6, verbose = FALSE)


```
